description: This file provides a shell script that wraps around the start-stop-daemon utility to manage system services. It includes functions to start, stop, check, reload, and send signals to services, handling environment variables for configuration, and parsing command-line arguments for different actions.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to perform actions like start, stop, check, or kill a service based on provided arguments.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if the specified service is alive.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service, defaulting to USR1 unless specified otherwise.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the specified service, attempting graceful shutdown before force killing.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads the specified service by sending the reload signal.
